meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: Claude会用Dask库处理超内存的大数据:把表格、数组或文本拆成小块并行计算,写出分步执行、最后汇总的Python代码。
howto.when: 当你要处理超过内存的数据、把pandas/NumPy代码并行化或跨机器运行,或一次读取多个CSV/Parquet文件时触发。

say.text: 我有50GB的CSV,用Dask按类别汇总销售额。

howto.what_en: Claude will use the Dask library for data too large for memory: split tables, arrays, or text into chunks, compute in parallel, and produce Python code that executes lazily and collects results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to process data exceeding RAM, parallelize or cluster-scale pandas/NumPy code, or read many CSV/Parquet files at once.

say_en.text: I have a 50GB CSV; use Dask to sum sales by category.
say_en.note: Claude reads with dask.dataframe and groupbys in parallel.

say_en.text: Rewrite this pandas code with Dask; the data doesn't fit in memory.
say_en.note: Claude turns it into lazy operations plus compute().

say_en.text: Use a Dask array to normalize this Zarr dataset and save it back.
